/-!
# Kernel cost of one `pairLF` (Theorem A, lane E1b): measurement module

Pieces copied from the regenerated `Data/Trial/T0Data` (`pcT1, pcT2` degree 24 on dyadic intervals; `pcTn0` constant).
Each declaration is ONE `decide +kernel` check of the real/imaginary-free rational output of `pairLF` against the
literal computed by the exact Python mirror (`phase2-data/consts/evalref_mirror.py`, Fractions; agrees with 30-digit
`mpmath` double quadrature to 1e-27).  Timing: see NOTES-E1B.md.
-/
